title: Fastrak
tagline: Expedite Venue Check-In with World ID and a Scannable QR-Code
description: Fastrak is meant to be used in venues as a part of the one time check-in process (kind of like Ethglobal). Specifically, it's meant to be used as another form of ID, proving that someone attending an event is human, and that they can be verified further by a government-issued ID or such. Fastrak is meant to expedite venue check-ins by automating the process of human verification, and speeding up waiting lines through the quick scanning of a QR-code. Once you get a QR-code, you can come and go from the venue freely.
how_its_made: This project uses the Worldcoin/id npm package, specifically utilizing the react widget to create an instance of a World ID to authorize venue access without the need for wristbands or nametags. This is used in tandem with a QR-Code generator, to create a QR-Code that can be changed based on Worldcoin's signal or proof.
